About

Hi, I’m Zain! I’m a second-year Mechanical Engineering student at McMaster University with a passion for aerospace. Over the past couple of years, I’ve been diving deeper into CAD, simulation, and prototyping, where I love taking ideas from sketches to working designs. Whether it’s modeling parts and assemblies, running stress tests, or building and testing prototypes, I enjoy learning by doing and seeing designs come to life. Outside of engineering, you’ll usually find me on the basketball court or in the gym, staying active and working on new goals.

Projects

Airport Luggage Organizer

End‑to‑end baggage system that scans barcodes and routes luggage automatically. Python logic coordinates timing and sensors; a rack‑and‑pinion ramp (modeled in Inventor) transfers bags. 3D‑printed guides and guards improved reliability during dry‑run tests.

Hospital Wastewater Treatment Plant

Polypropylene porous‑filter concept tuned for ciprofloxacin removal with a documented eco‑audit. Material choices were screened in Granta EduPack; porosity and flow path were optimized for maintainability and regulatory compliance considerations.

Burner Buddy — Stovetop Indicator

Assistive, modular tactile indicator that clips to the stove edge to show burner position. Birch plywood body and suction‑cup stabilizer; components are sized for gloved use and low‑vision ergonomics. Rapid prototypes helped refine grip, clearance, and surface safety.

Read more
InventorRapid PrototypingLaser CuttingWoodworking3D Modeling
Aircraft simulation

Aircraft exterior modeled in Inventor with simplified wing/fuselage surfaces and modeled with an aluminum 6061 body. Ran FEA under a 55° climb at 150 m/s to check stress and pressure; mesh and constraints were iterated until margins met target safety factors.
